name: Coinbase and Kraken BTC/USD spot reference
description: Event-driven two-venue BTC/USD reference with a one-second health publication. Each constituent is the exact-decimal midpoint of displayed best bid and ask from the declared ticker input. The reference is the equal-weight arithmetic mean of both fresh unrounded constituent midpoints. Ready output requires positive uncrossed quotes received no more than 10000 milliseconds before production and cross-venue midpoint dispersion no greater than 10 basis points relative to the reference. Readiness guards evaluate full internal decimal precision before decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even; quality state and reasons are authoritative if a published value rounds to a guard boundary. A non-ready update omits reference_price and uses fixed quality reason codes rather than substituting a stale or single-venue price. reference_time is the latest provider event time among fresh constituents and is omitted when neither constituent is fresh.
